title: 3 PMA cadets finish Korean language course with honors

blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Three Philippine Military Academy Class of 2029 cadets completed their Korean language course with distinction before attending military academies in South Korea as part of a foreign exchange program. Army Cadet Charlie Mark Bumanglag, a 20-year-old resident of Baguio City, topped the course attended by 69 cadets and officers from 25 countries during graduation rites at the Korean Defense Language Institute on November 18. Bumanglag will next attend the Republic of Korea Military Academy under PMA’s Foreign Pre-Commission Training Institution Program.
